title: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) VPN Deployment via Microsoft Intune
hook: Deploy the Cisco VPN client to every managed device from the cloud
problem: Getting the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) onto a fleet reliably — the right app, the right VPN profile, on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android — is where remote-access projects stall. This solution packages and deploys the Secure Client and its VPN configuration profiles through Microsoft Intune, so every enrolled device gets a consistent, tested VPN connection with no hands-on touch, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Secure Client is delivered per platform (Win32/line-of-business app, macOS PKG, iOS/Android store app + VPN profile), the app-plus-profile model, and where Intune ends and the Cisco head-end begins.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing + enrollment, Entra ID groups, a Cisco VPN head-end/ISE, the Secure Client installers/XML profile, platform enrollment) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to package the client for each platform, build the VPN device-configuration profiles in Intune, assign to a named pilot group, then validate, pilot, and expand fleet-wide.
5 PowerShell scripts — deployment-readiness discovery, per-device install/profile validation, a VPN client + profile coverage report, safe remediation of failed installs, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Package and deploy the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) and its VPN profiles across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android through Microsoft Intune — consistent, hands-off remote access, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Package and deploy the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) and its VPN profiles across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android through Microsoft Intune — consistent, hands-off remote access, pilot-first.
meta_title: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) VPN Deployment via Microsoft Intune

author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Cisco ISE / Secure Client + Intune integration; certificate/posture/network-profile work, live-access risk).

Cisco ISE and Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) console/profile-editor internals are deferred to Cisco's official documentation (no fabricated menus); the Intune, Entra, and certificate side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
